snippet.title: No Beer Left Behind! Demo. Steam. Itch #gameplay #sokoban #puzzle #pixelart #steam #demo #2d
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4840850?utm_source=youtube

2D sokoban puzzle game with pixel art and an 8-bit soundtrack. You play as a dwarf tidying up his cellars. The goal is simple: get every barrel onto its marked spot, and the level is solved.
